$comment: The Bicep CLI every IaC check in this repository uses. The release does not publish a checksum file; the sha256 values below are the 'digest' field GitHub's release API reports for each asset (computed by GitHub when the asset was uploaded), read on 2026-11-03 from https://api.github.com/repos/Azure/bicep/releases/latest. A match proves the download is the file GitHub holds, not who built it: no signature is verified. Only linux-x64 was downloaded and checked on that date; the other digests are copied from the same API response and have not been verified by a download.
